ck: (34)kasitinanacarya vinata atnana iti yatyapyatra vyavaharikapetasya paran pratyasitya satyaprasiti tatapi vyavaharakocarapetasunyatvasya satyatvana tosa paranate paranartikasyEva vyavaharakocaratvat yatva prahnacnanetarapatyapetasunyatvan satyan na ca pratyaksavirutatvanEvananunanasanpava iti vacyan paranartato na pityanta ityasya prananatrayavirutatvat taca vyutpatitan anukulatarkapavatiti na cEkye lakavanevanukulatarka iti vacyan lakavasya prananapatitatvat anyata paranalakavat sunyavatanevankikurya prahnatiriktaviyatatyasesaprananikaprapancasyatyantanupapanavityakalpitatvakalpana eva kOravaca tatpokayatanatva iti tevatatasariravacinacEtanyapokavacetakatve satye pata ityarta anyata yacnatatasarirasukatO tevatatasya nanetanityatyanusantanapateriti pava pata iti satyaprasitya pakse satyasatvanirvaha ityarta ata tevatatapratiyokikaparanartikapetapavavatpokavacetakatvasya satyakatakatvanayan pata yacnatatatestatrsapetapavavatvasanpavat atava tevatatapinapokanavacetakatve sati pokavacetakatvanatran satyanastu pokturtevatatatvanartat setsyatiti cetevanapi tevatatayacnatatatinan paranartikapetakrahakoktavitapratyaksatiprananapato turvara na ca tesanaprananyan prananye patakapavat palavatvirotipranananupalanpatiti evanatra tevatatakarnanirnitatvanupatirityatikan ca trastavyan atra prakuktatose paroktasanatanan tusayitunaha — susuptanucriteti vivrtanetatatastat tvayetyati tata ca punarpata eveti pava ata tevatatapokayatanatvasya paranartikatvenapavepi vyavaharikatvena tatsatvapyupakanatena rupena tatapavanatikaranatvasya satyatvana patavakasa na ca paran prati vyavaharikatvaprasiti saprakarakacnanapatyatvena pokayatanatvasya yopavastatanatikaranatvasyEvasatyatvat saprakarakacnanapatyatvasya ca paranate paranartika eva prasitereti cena saprakarakacnanapatyatvena pokayatanatvapavasyEvaprasite vyatikaranatarnavacinapavanankikaripi sananyarupena visesapavanapyupakanat na ca saprakarakacnanapatyatvavisistapokayatanatvatvena pokayatanatvapavasya vivaksitatvana tosa iti vacyan tasya kevalapokayatanatvatvapeksaya kurutvenapavapratiyokitanavacetakatvat etena pokayatanatvasya nityatve tatatyantapavavatatatikaranatvasyapi nityatvena
